label: The thesis that no content in its scope is ABSOLUTELY_TRUE_1, if it is in…, by Constructive-proof
meaning: Horn 1 for "there is no absolute truth", by the self-application dilemma (imported from LOGIC-SELF-APPLICATION-DILEMMA): if the thesis is in its own scope and disquotes, it is not absolutely true, so asserting it absolutely is incoherent. Not a refutation of the thesis held as true for its speaker (STMT-NO-ABSOLUTE-TRUTH-MODELS).
